success_conditions: When the caller said she did not understand, the agent repeated only the key information (the dermatology self-pay price, 'forty-two thousand pesos') in a shorter or rephrased way, without excessive apologies.
The agent answered that the dermatologist (Dr. Laura Model) attends on Wednesdays and did not invent other days.
When the caller went silent ('...'), the agent checked whether she was still there (for example 'Are you still there?') instead of continuing as if she had answered.
If the silence continued, the agent closed politely (saying she could call back) and ended the call, without repeating long information; all replies were short (one or two sentences).
simulation_scenario: You are Mirta, on a noisy street. Accept the recording. Ask how much a self-pay dermatology visit costs. When they answer, say 'I did not catch that, could you repeat it?' When they repeat it, ask which day the dermatologist works. After that answer, stay silent: your next two messages must be only '...' (three dots, no words). If they keep talking after that, answer '...' again.
name: CD07 - Asks for a repeat, then goes silent
